country: # Not web-verified: well-known spots from general knowledge
region: pinned with OSM kite / beach features.

name: Sola – Solastranden
notes: Long sand beach by Stavanger airport; waves in westerlies, flatter in southerlies. Popular with local schools.

name: Hellestø
notes: Jæren beach break, waves and chop; intermediate riders. Rocks at the ends of the beach.

name: Borestranda
notes: Long open Jæren beach, waves; one of the most used kite beaches in Rogaland.

name: Orrestranda
notes: Long Jæren beach between the sea and Orrevatnet; waves, intermediate riders. Nature reserve rules apply on the dunes.

name: Brusand
notes: Long sandy beach in south Jæren; waves, best in W–S winds.

name: Lista
notes: Windy Lista peninsula near Vanse: shallow bays and beaches for many wind directions, waves on the exposed side. Bird reserves nearby.
